_comment: Rough cost of analysing 100 photographs, for the confirmation prompt.
Not billing: the provider's dashboard is the authority on money.
Re-check when a vendor changes prices; `checked` is when somebody last did.

note: The token counts are measured, not guessed. A live Stage 3 call on this
archive returned 2170 input and 770 output tokens for two frames, giving
1085 in / 385 out per photograph. Stage 2 sends the same 512px preview in
groups of twelve and returns one small JSON object per frame: ~1000 in and
~70 out. Both stages run on every photograph, so they add.
Honest caveat: only grok-4.6 is derived this way. The two gpt-5.6 figures
predate the formula and were order-of-magnitude estimates -- they are kept
because they are the right order and marked derived:false rather than
recomputed from token prices this project has no published source for.
